messages:
maya: FYI — I'm updating the API keys rotate/revoke modal in Figma. Would love quick eyes on copy, keyboard flow, and accessibility + empty-state behavior. prototype: https://figma.com/proto/abc123 (obvs placeholder)
eli: Quick skim — primary CTA reads `Rotate` right now, which feels ambiguous when there are multiple keys. Suggest `Rotate key` or `Rotate this key`.
jordan: Also think we should surface 'Used by' inline (small text) so people know which integrations will break. Maybe a `Check usage` link beside it.
sam: Frontend note: modal currently traps focus but we need to explicitly move focus after rotation. should we focus the new `Copy` button? Or the toast?
nora: Accessibility nit: when rotation completes, announce with aria-live="polite": "New API key generated. New key copied to clipboard." Also don't read raw key material to screen readers — prefer: "New key generated. Use the reveal button to view the full key."
maya: Good call. How long should the generated key be visible before auto-hide? We use 10s for some flows. Thoughts?
eli: I'd go 15s to give users time across devices, copying from clipboard can be flaky. Show a visible `Copy` button with accessible label `Copy new API key` and helper text: "This is the only time the full key is shown."
sam: Backend already flags one-time keys with `one_time_key`. Frontend snippet we can use: 
```
if (resp.one_time_key) {
  showKey(resp.key)
  startTimer(15000)
}
```
We should also prevent accidental screen-scraping.
nora: Keyboard flow: after rotation, move focus to the toast's Copy button. Tab order should let people reveal the key and copy without jumping back to the underlying list.
jordan: Copy text: avoid shorthand `Copied!`. Prefer full sentence: "API key copied to clipboard." It's clearer for everyone.
eli: Empty state copy tweak: current line says `You have no API keys yet.` Suggest more actionable: `No API keys yet — create one to start using the API` with primary CTA `Create key`.
maya: Also adding permission badges per key useful: `Scope: read-only` or `Scope: full access`. And an ellipsis menu for rotate/revoke/inspect.
sam: Revoke flow: we have a destructive modal. For very-used keys (used by >=3 apps) consider an extra confirmation checkbox: `I understand this will break integrations`. Otherwise friction for simple deletes might be too high.
nora: Don't rely on color for danger states. Add an icon + explicit aria-label on the confirmation. e.g., `aria-label="Confirm revoke API key"`.
maya: Telemetry idea: record whether user used rotate or revoke within 30s of viewing modal. Helps spot accidental clicks.
jordan: Timeline: want to ship a small A/B test for copy variants (short vs explanatory). Ship A as default, track downstream help-desk volume.
eli: Copy alternatives — posting variants here:
```
Variant A:
Primary: "Rotate key"
Body: "You'll get a new API key. This is the only time it will be visible."

Variant B:
Primary: "Rotate key now"
Body: "Generating a new key will invalidate the current key. You will need to update any integrations that use it."
```
nora: I prefer B — more explicit and helps screen-reader users understand consequence.
maya: Thanks — I'll update Figma and add ARIA notes (aria-live regions, focus targets, labels). Will post a new screenshot when it's in. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 22:30 PST (automated:deploy)
maya: Filed a tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/KEYS-321 assigned to @sam. ETA: next sprint.
